prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
UKIP Manifesto 2017 – Summary (ideological framing preserved)

Believe in Britain. Believe in our values. Deliver a real, clean Brexit. UKIP is the insurance policy and guard dogs of Brexit, leading where others follow.

Real Brexit: six key tests
- Legal: full parliamentary supremacy; no ECJ/ECHR jurisdiction unless we choose it.
- Migration: full control of borders; no freedom of movement; UK-set targets.
- Maritime: restore our 200-mile Exclusive Economic Zone; no CFP; land fish in Britain.
- Trade: leave single market/customs union; retake UK’s WTO seat; strike our own deals.
- Money: no “divorce bill”; recover UK assets (e.g., EIB stake).
- Time: Brexit complete by end-2019. Repeal 1972 Act; revoke 1964 London Fishing Convention. Bring back the blue passport.

Sound finances, lower bills, no tax hikes
- Fund priorities from £35bn savings: cut foreign aid to 0.2% GNI, scrap HS2, reform Barnett, end EU budget payments.
- Cost-of-living: remove VAT and “green levies” from household energy; abolish TV licence; remove VAT from hot takeaway food and sanitary products.
- Taxes: raise personal allowance to £13,500; lift 40% threshold to £55,000; raise IHT threshold to £500k each; no NI/tax hikes for the self‑employed.

Backing jobs, business and towns
- Cut business rates 20% for premises under £50k RV; stop late payment abuse; open public contracts to SMEs; no quarterly tax returns.
- British jobs for British workers: advertise domestically first; lawful preference for under‑25s; enforce workers’ rights; curb zero-hours abuse.
- Coastal Enterprise Zones: 50% rates cut, housing renewal powers, priority regeneration.

Homes people can afford
- Build up to 100,000 high-quality factory-built modular homes a year on brownfield; sold freehold under £100k to UK first‑time buyers under 40; resale back to HDC at cost-plus-inflation.

NHS and mental health first
- Extra £11bn a year by 2021/22 for NHS and social care; integrate health and care in a single department.
- Train more staff: lift medical school cap; restore nurse/midwife bursaries; scrap hospital parking; end PFI rip‑offs.
- A national service: non‑urgent care only for citizens or those who’ve paid UK tax for 5 years; require comprehensive medical insurance for others.
- Mental health: +£500m/year; 28‑day max wait; school counselling nationwide; dedicated forces/veterans support.

Respect for families, elderly and disabled
- Keep triple lock and universal pensioner benefits; up to £2bn/year for social care; dignity code; no zero‑hours for home care.
- Reform unfair PIP and Work Capability Assessments; raise Carer’s Allowance; 50‑50 shared parenting; transparency in Family Courts; SEN childcare fund.

Fair, balanced migration and real integration
- Net migration to zero over five years via an Australian‑style points/permit system; moratorium on low‑skilled migration; seasonal worker visas; value test for applicants.
- One law for all: disband sharia councils; ban face coverings in public; zero tolerance for FGM, breast ironing, honour crime; tough school standards against Islamist extremism.

Law, order and borders
- +20,000 police, +7,000 prison officers, +4,000 Border Force; restore Stop & Search; deport foreign criminals; opt out of the European Arrest Warrant.

Defence and veterans
- Real 2% of GDP on defence plus £1bn/year by end of parliament; +20,000 personnel; keep nuclear deterrent; no EU military integration.
- Veterans’ Administration; guaranteed jobs (police/prison/border) after 12 years’ service; end legal witch‑hunts; tackle homelessness.

Trade, not aid
- Close DfID; reduce aid to 0.2% GNI; refocus on clean water, vaccines and disaster relief; commission a UK hospital ship; pursue ethical free trade, especially with developing nations.

Transport, environment, farming, energy
- Scrap HS2; oppose Heathrow expansion; back regional airports; EV charging rollout; protect diesel drivers; support rural buses.
- New Environmental Protection Act; protect ancient woodland; prefer brownfield; tackle plastic waste.
- Replace CAP with a fair UK Single Farm Payment (cap £120k; pay active farmers; organic/hill farm bonuses); ban live export for slaughter; CCTV in abattoirs; clear labelling.
- Repeal Climate Change Act; leave Paris/ETS; diversify supply (nuclear, gas, shale, renewables when competitive); no fracking in national parks; cut energy costs.

Real democracy and local power
- Abolish House of Lords; create an English Parliament; halve Commons to 325; proportional representation; binding citizen‑initiated referenda; scrap on‑demand postal voting.
- Local binding referenda; committee governance; low council tax; cut waste.

If you believe in Britain—and in a real Brexit—vote UKIP.
